title: Branch A (Day 25) — Build the Fix

setting.summary: With enough tools, you attempt a hands-on repair. The rig fights you with rust, grit, and missing seals.

must_include: A repair sequence with concrete steps
A measurable benefit (safer water / reduced future risk)

beats.notes: Tie success/partial success to tools and patience.
Reward should be framed as future stability, not instant miracle.
